g3-implement.title: save() atomicity: make the spine write atomic
g3-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer. FILE FENCE for this gate: scripts/checklist_engine.py plus a NEW test module, and the one stale docstring at tests/test_crew_launcher.py:3250 — nothing else. scripts/mcp_spine_server.py belongs to g2. Task: checklist_engine.save (:237) ends in a bare Path(path).write_bytes(payload), which truncates then writes, so a concurrent reader can observe a partial spine and a crash mid-write can leave one permanently corrupt. Replace with the repo's OWN canonical pattern, do not invent one: mirror scripts/hooks/gauge_writer_hook.py:513 _atomic_write_json — write a temp sibling in the SAME directory, then os.replace(tmp, path), which is atomic on POSIX and Windows alike. Preserve save()'s existing line-ending behaviour exactly (_dominant_newline must still be consulted BEFORE the original file is replaced) and clean up the temp file on failure. PROTECTED INTENT, must appear in the docstring: atomic replace fixes torn reads and crash corruption, it does NOT fix lost updates — two writers that each load-mutate-save still clobber each other and leave a well-formed file. That is #613's other half and is out of scope. Do NOT touch _RAIL_STRINGS or _refresh_attach_hint (fenced, lane C needs their text).

preconditions.statement: no dependency on g2 — different file, parallel-safe

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

constraints: Reuse the repo's existing atomic-write pattern; no new abstraction.
Do not silently widen scope into the lost-update half.
